title: Barbecue Sauce
preamble:
1 tablespoon olive oil

1 onion, finely chopped

400g can chopped tomatoes

3 garlic cloves, finely chopped

1 medium chilli
method: Heat oil in a saucepan and add the onion.
Cook over a gentle heat 4-5 mins, until softened.
Add remaining ingredients, season and mix.
Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-30 mins, until thickened.
For a smooth sauce, simply blend the mixture in a food processor or with a hand blender for a few seconds.
